bagPolicy.summary: American Family Insurance Amphitheater does not publish one universal bag rule for every event. Review the official event information before arrival because size and type restrictions may vary.
bagPolicy.note: Policies may change or vary by event. Review the linked official guidance shortly before arrival.

parking.note: Parking can be reserved in advance through SpotHero or Parkwhiz for lots within walking distance. Event parking is first-come, first-served, and tailgating is not allowed. Accessible parking requires appropriate plates or permits.

rideshare.note: On event days, rideshare pickups and drop-offs are directed to North Jackson Street near the South Gate.

concessions.note: The American Family Insurance Amphitheater offers a variety of local food options including BBQ sandwiches, bratwurst, nachos, and pretzels. Beverage options include a wide range of MolsonCoors products, non-alcoholic drinks, spirits, wine, and specialty cocktails.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Accessible parking spaces are available in Lot H located directly outside of the Summerfest South Gate.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in American Family Insurance Amphitheater's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: During Summerfest, the Box Office is open from 10:00 am - 9:00 pm on festival days The American Family Insurance Amphitheater and Box Office are located on the south end of the Henry Maier Festival Park Grounds at the end of East Summerfest Place east of Harbor Drive.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at American Family Insurance Amphitheater. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
